summary: Verified install.sh --license flag fix and regression backend endpoints. Downloaded tarball from /api/plugin/download, extracted, ran bash -n (syntax OK), and executed install.sh --license=MS-TEST --dry-run. No 'Unknown flag' error — script now exits with expected 'WHM/cPanel not detected. Aborting.' (acceptable in preview env). Also verified case handlers (--license=*, --license-server=*) and the [license] config-writing block are present. install-info wget_one_liner includes '--license=MS-TEST'. Tarball contains scripts/heartbeat.pl and install.sh at top level. All 4 regression endpoints return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: reseller login endpoint is /api/reseller/auth/login (not /api/auth/login) — review request had the wrong path but auth works fine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for install.sh --license=... flag is verified end-to-end. Tarball built on-the-fly from /app/whm-plugin/ correctly ships fixed install.sh. Regression endpoints /api/analytics/mrr, /api/pricing, /api/plugin/install-info, /api/reseller/invoices (with JWT from /api/reseller/auth/login) all 200.
rca of the issue: Original install.sh case statement lacked --license=* pattern, causing 'Unknown flag' error and exit 1 when reseller ran the wget_one_liner from install-info. Fix added --license=* and --license-server=* handlers plus a config-writing block that persists [license] key + server_url into /etc/mailshield/mailshield.conf. Verified fix is present both in /app/whm-plugin/install.sh source and in the served tarball from /api/plugin/download.
